text: Binge-watch. I had been binge-watching for three hours when the Wi-Fi died.
Spoiler. My friend sent me a spoiler while I was watching.
Cliffhanger. The episode ended with a cliffhanger, and I screamed.
Plot twist. I was eating popcorn when the plot twist came.
Subtitles. I always watch with subtitles in English.
Season finale. I had been waiting for the season finale all week.
Rewatch. I rewatched my favorite part three times.
Buffering. The video was buffering while the music was getting louder.
I was watching the finale when the screen froze.
While my mom was cooking, I was watching my series.
I had been waiting for that episode all week.
I had been watching for three hours when the Wi-Fi died.
No spoilers, please!

Sophia, it's Ruby. I finally watched the season finale! I had been trying to watch it since Saturday, and last night it worked. I was sitting in the kitchen, my mom was making tea, and nobody was talking. And the cliffhanger? Wow. Don't worry, no spoilers! But tell me, what were you watching last weekend? You always watch alone, right? Call me back!
